name: D20 Magic Dice
source:
D20 Magic Dice is a visual novel for adults, about adults (all characters are over 21, some are even over 121). Where you, as the protagonist of this story, will have the opportunity to immerse yourself in relationships with familiar characters. Communicate with them, develop your relationships and become “closer” with them.
Life is a complicated thing, who knows where it will take you in a year, a day, or sometimes even a second. Here you are, as if sitting with friends at a party, and the next moment you find yourself in an endless white space, where your only interlocutor is a dice from a board game. Which not only hears all your thoughts, but can also turn them into reality.
Turn all thoughts into reality…
